t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in specific pairs every single time they appear on screen. One half of the gnomes lead us to a brightly coloured forest with a red basket and the other half of the gnomes lead us to a less bright forest with a yellow basket. The accessories that the gnomes have on their outfits, of their size etc. don't have any bearing on where they take us, it's the block colours on their clothing that I need to look out for. It's important to try and remember which gnome takes us to which forest and to them figure out where we get the most mushrooms from within that. The number of mushrooms in each forest is different every time.

vb_textbox.text: The 1.5 seconds you get to make your decision in terms of the choice of gnomes is no time at all, so it's really important you remain aware and alert. Also ensure your fingers are poised above the keys S and K and also the space bar.I found that the amount of mushrooms really varied massively throughout the game, even when concentrating on and selecting specific coloured gnomes.The purple, dark pink, brown and green gnomes seemed to work well for me in terms of the amount of mushrooms, however they did vary throughout the game.The most important thing is to remain alert, don't take your eye off the screen, make sure your fingers are above the keys you need to press and make sure you take full advantage of the breaks.
